Interface SecretManager

All Known Subinterfaces:
AWSSecretsManager, LocalEncryptedSecretManager, VaultSecretManager
All Known Implementing Classes:
AWSSecretsManager, LocalEncryptedSecretManagerImpl, VaultSecretManager
public interface SecretManager
Core abstraction for secret management across multiple backends. Supported backends: - HashiCorp Vault (recommended for production) - AWS Secrets Manager - Azure Key Vault - Local encrypted storage (dev/standalone) Features: - Automatic secret rotation - Version management - Audit logging - Multi-tenancy support - Encryption at rest - TTL and lease management All operations are asynchronous and return Uni for Quarkus integration.

    • store

      io.smallrye.mutiny.Uni<SecretMetadata> store(StoreSecretRequest request)
      Store a secret with automatic encryption.
      Parameters:
      request - Secret storage request containing tenant ID, path, data, type, and metadata
      Returns:
      Secret metadata with assigned version number
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if request validation fails
      SecretException - on backend errors

    • retrieve

      io.smallrye.mutiny.Uni<Secret> retrieve(RetrieveSecretRequest request)
      Retrieve a secret by path and optional version. Returns decrypted secret data only to authenticated and authorized users.
      Parameters:
      request - Secret retrieval request with version (optional)
      Returns:
      Decrypted secret value with metadata
      Throws:
      SecretException - if not found or access denied

    • delete

      io.smallrye.mutiny.Uni<Void> delete(DeleteSecretRequest request)
      Delete a secret (soft delete with retention by default). Soft delete retains the secret for the configured retention period. Hard delete immediately and permanently removes the secret.
      Parameters:
      request - Delete request specifying soft/hard delete and reason
      Returns:
      Void on successful deletion
      Throws:
      SecretException - on failure

    • list

      io.smallrye.mutiny.Uni<List<SecretMetadata>> list(String tenantId, String path)
      List secrets in a path (metadata only, no values). Useful for discovering secrets and managing lifecycle without exposing values.
      Parameters:
      tenantId - Tenant identifier
      path - Path prefix for filtering
      Returns:
      List of secret metadata (without secret values)
      Throws:
      SecretException - on access denied

    • rotate

      io.smallrye.mutiny.Uni<SecretMetadata> rotate(RotateSecretRequest request)
      Rotate a secret (create new version, optionally deprecate old). Rotation creates a new version while optionally marking the old as deprecated. Clients should migrate to the new version within the grace period.
      Parameters:
      request - Rotation request with new data and deprecation flag
      Returns:
      New secret metadata with incremented version
      Throws:
      SecretException - on failure

    • exists

      io.smallrye.mutiny.Uni<Boolean> exists(String tenantId, String path)
      Check if a secret exists without retrieving it. Fast operation for conditional logic without decryption.
      Parameters:
      tenantId - Tenant identifier
      path - Secret path
      Returns:
      True if secret exists and is not deleted
      Throws:
      SecretException - on access denied

    • getMetadata

      io.smallrye.mutiny.Uni<SecretMetadata> getMetadata(String tenantId, String path)
      Get secret metadata without retrieving the value. Returns metadata only (creation date, version, status, etc.) Safe to expose in logs without revealing sensitive information.
      Parameters:
      tenantId - Tenant identifier
      path - Secret path
      Returns:
      Secret metadata
      Throws:
